Files NOT downloaded (present in the Zenodo record but out of scope for this
ingestion — they are experiment software and analysis scripts, not data, and
are not needed for the sanity-check parser):
  - Analysis.zip (4166362 bytes, md5 74c603b6df43c6c30ab2a35ef35fa730) —
    R/Python scripts used to produce the paper's statistical analysis and
    figures (MaxLik.py, PathByPeriod.r, RankSumTest.r, Truth.r, etc.).
  - Program.zip (15455733 bytes, md5 4975d6d45f558e2e80a7aac4d39c4cba) —
    the Windows .exe/.dll client-server software used to run the lab
    experiment sessions.
  Both are covered by the same CC-BY-4.0 license as the data file and can be
  fetched from the same record if a future task needs them; they were left
  out here to keep this ingestion scoped to the actual dataset.
